name: reblebi
description: Reblebi: çok platformlu sosyal medya yayın, hikaye ve DM otomasyon platformu (panel + API + MCP)

scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w server && npm run build -w web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w web
